---
title: "02 — Q1: algorithm and parameters"
author: "Adrien Taudière"
---

Effect of the classification algorithm and its parameters on the mock
community. Figures: Q1.2 (per-rank × method), Q1.3 (bootstrap sweep), Q1.4
(blastn vote sweep); tables: Q1.6 (means and win matrix), Q1.7 (mixed model).

Every section has one tab per mock and ITSx region (`analysis_views()` in
`00_setup.R`), on the ASVs: Pauvert ITS1, then Tedersoo ITS1, ITS2 and full.
The figures are saved once per view, suffixed with it
(`fig_q1_methods_pauvert_ITS1`, …).

```{r setup}
here::i_am("analysis/02_q1_methods.qmd")  # _quarto.yml would otherwise make here() root = analysis/
source(here::here("analysis/00_setup.R"))
res_all <- cache_read("res_comp_tax")
views <- analysis_views(res_all)
```

## Summary

```{r summary-data}
#| include: false
# Every figure of this summary is computed from the same views and filters
# as the tabs below (view_rows(), filter_default_settings()).
s02_rows <- view_rows(res_all, views)
s02_f1 <- s02_rows |>
  filter(metrics == "F1_score") |>
  filter_default_settings()
s02_by_algo <- s02_f1 |>
  group_by(view, tax_level, algo) |>
  summarise(value = mean(values), lo = min(values), hi = max(values), .groups = "drop")
s02_genus <- filter(s02_by_algo, tax_level == "Genus")
s02_spread <- s02_genus |>
  group_by(view) |>
  summarise(spread = max(value) - min(value), .groups = "drop")
s02_boot <- s02_rows |>
  filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Genus", algo %in% c("dada2", "sintax")) |>
  group_by(view, algo, bootstrap_num) |>
  summarise(value = mean(values), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(view, algo) |>
  summarise(
    delta = value[bootstrap_num == 0.6] - value[bootstrap_num == 0.4],
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# Words that follow the numbers, so that no adjective outlives the data.
s02_boot_word <- if (max(abs(s02_boot$delta)) < 0.03) {
  "at most 0.03 either way: the default 0.5 is not a sensitive choice"
} else {
  "more than 0.03 in at least one view: the threshold matters there"
}
```

Default settings, ASVs, F1 averaged over the nine reference databases; one
value per view (`r paste(views$label, collapse = ", ")`).

- **Genus**: the best method is `r best_phrase(s02_genus, "algo")`; best
  minus worst method `r fmt_range(s02_spread$spread)` per view.
- **Species** is no longer a primary endpoint here (OD 43): it is read by
  exact and near match in chapter 09; the `Gen_sp` rows below are secondary.
- **Bootstrap** (dada2, sintax): raising `min_bootstrap` from 0.4 to 0.6
  changes the Genus F1 by `r fmt_range(s02_boot$delta[s02_boot$algo == "dada2"])`
  for dada2 and `r fmt_range(s02_boot$delta[s02_boot$algo == "sintax"])` for
  sintax, `r s02_boot_word`.

```{r summary-fig}
#| echo: false
fig_summary_02_f1_by_rank <- s02_by_algo |>
  filter(tax_level != "Gen_sp") |>
  mutate(tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = setdiff(tax_order, "Gen_sp"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tax_level, y = value, colour = algo, group = algo)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~view, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Rank", y = "F1 (mean over databases; bar = min–max)",
    colour = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
print(fig_summary_02_f1_by_rank)
save_fig(fig_summary_02_f1_by_rank, "fig_summary_02_f1_by_rank", width = 16, height = 5)
```

## Q1.2 — Per-rank × method (ACC, F1, MCC)

Comparing the four methods at bootstrap 0.5; blastn shown with `rel_majority`
vote (the default; see Q1.4 for the vote-algorithm sweep).

```{r q1-2, results = "asis"}
view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  fig_q1_methods <- res |>
    filter(metrics %in% c("ACC", "F1_score", "MCC")) |>
    filter_default_settings() |>
    mutate(tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = algo, y = values, fill = db)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
    facet_grid(metrics ~ tax_level) +
    labs(x = "Method", y = "Value", fill = "Database") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(fig_q1_methods)
  save_fig(fig_q1_methods, paste0("fig_q1_methods_", v$id), width = 16, height = 7)
})
```

## Q1.3 — Bootstrap sweep (dada2 & sintax)

F1 and MCC across `min_bootstrap ∈ {0.4, 0.5, 0.6}` per rank.

```{r q1-3, results = "asis"}
view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  fig_q1_bootstrap <- res |>
    filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "MCC")) |>
    filter(algo %in% c("dada2", "sintax")) |>
    filter(!startsWith(db, "mini_")) |>
    mutate(tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(bootstrap_num), y = values, fill = db)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
    facet_grid(metrics + algo ~ tax_level) +
    labs(x = "Min bootstrap", y = "Value", fill = "Database") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(fig_q1_bootstrap)
  save_fig(fig_q1_bootstrap, paste0("fig_q1_bootstrap_", v$id), width = 16, height = 9)
})
```

## Q1.4 — Blastn vote-algorithm sweep

F1 and MCC across `c("rel_majority", "abs_majority", "unanimity")` per rank × DB,
at the default `min_id = 95` (the `min_id` and `lca_cutoff` sweeps get their own
figures in ROADMAP 0.8).

```{r q1-4, results = "asis"}
view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  fig_q1_blastn <- res |>
    filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "MCC")) |>
    filter(algo == "blastn", min_id == 95) |>
    filter(!startsWith(db, "mini_")) |>
    mutate(tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = vote_algorithm, y = values, fill = db)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
    facet_grid(metrics ~ tax_level) +
    labs(x = "Vote algorithm", y = "Value", fill = "Database") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(fig_q1_blastn)
  save_fig(fig_q1_blastn, paste0("fig_q1_blastn_vote_", v$id), width = 16, height = 7)
})
```

## Q1.6 — Per-rank method comparison table and win matrix

```{r q1-6, results = "asis"}
view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  method_summary_tbl <- res |>
    filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "ACC")) |>
    filter_default_settings() |>
    group_by(tax_level, algo, metrics) |>
    summarise(
      mean_val = round(mean(values, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      sd_val   = round(sd(values, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(mean_sd = paste0(mean_val, " (±", sd_val, ")")) |>
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols     = c(tax_level, algo),
      names_from  = metrics,
      values_from = mean_sd
    ) |>
    mutate(tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order)) |>
    arrange(tax_level, algo)
  cat_kable(
    method_summary_tbl,
    col.names = c("Rank", "Method", "ACC", "F1"),
    caption   = "Mean (±sd) F1 and ACC per method × rank (bootstrap = 0.5, averaged across DBs)"
  )

  win_matrix_tbl <- res |>
    filter(metrics == "F1_score") |>
    filter_default_settings() |>
    group_by(tax_level, db) |>
    # A win shared by n tied methods counts 1 / n for each (code review §4.1).
    filter(values == max(values)) |>
    mutate(share = 1 / n()) |>
    ungroup() |>
    count(tax_level, algo, wt = share, name = "n_wins") |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = algo,
      values_from = n_wins,
      values_fill = 0
    ) |>
    mutate(
      tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order),
      across(-tax_level, \(x) round(x, 2))
    ) |>
    arrange(tax_level)
  cat_kable(
    win_matrix_tbl,
    caption = "Win matrix: number of DBs where each method achieves highest F1 per rank (bootstrap = 0.5); a win shared by n methods counts 1/n"
  )
})
```

## Q1.7 — Statistical test: F1 ~ method + (1|db) per rank

Linear mixed model with DB as random intercept, testing whether the method
fixed effect explains significant variance in F1 (LRT vs. null model). Requires
`lme4`.

```{r q1-7, results = "asis"}
lmm_by_rank <- function(res) {
  lapply(
    intersect(tax_order, unique(res$tax_level)),
    function(rank) {
      dat <- res |>
        filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == rank) |>
        filter_default_settings()
      if (nrow(dat) < 8 || dplyr::n_distinct(dat$db) < 3) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      tryCatch({
        m_full <- lme4::lmer(values ~ algo + (1 | db), data = dat, REML = FALSE)
        m_null <- lme4::lmer(values ~ 1 + (1 | db), data = dat, REML = FALSE)
        lrt    <- anova(m_null, m_full)
        tibble::tibble(
          tax_level = rank,
          LRT_chisq = round(lrt$Chisq[2], 3),
          df        = as.integer(lrt[["Chi Df"]][2]),
          p_value   = round(lrt[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2], 4),
          signif    = dplyr::case_when(
            lrt[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2] < 0.001 ~ "***",
            lrt[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2] < 0.01  ~ "**",
            lrt[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2] < 0.05  ~ "*",
            TRUE ~ ""
          )
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        tibble::tibble(tax_level = rank, LRT_chisq = NA_real_,
                       df = NA_integer_, p_value = NA_real_, signif = "ERROR")
      })
    }
  ) |>
    dplyr::bind_rows() |>
    mutate(tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order)) |>
    arrange(tax_level)
}

view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  cat_kable(
    lmm_by_rank(res),
    caption = "LRT: F1 ~ method + (1|db) vs. null (1|db) per rank. *** p<0.001, ** p<0.01, * p<0.05."
  )
})
```

## Under Q2b (OD 44)

Every section above reads the lead truth rule, `no_truth_aside`: the real
units without a truth (best hit 90–99.5 % to a mock member) leave the
scoring, so the chapter measures the assignment step, not how well the
sequencing represents the community. Under `q2b` they stay in it, wrong when
named and missed when left NA (chapter 01, OD 44).

```{r q2b-data}
#| include: false
s02_rules <- compare_truth_rules(function(rule) {
  view_rows(res_all, views, truth_rule = rule) |>
    filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Genus") |>
    filter_default_settings() |>
    group_by(view, algo) |>
    summarise(value = mean(values), .groups = "drop")
}, "algo")
```

The best method at Genus `r rule_holds_phrase(s02_rules)`.

```{r q2b-table}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(
  s02_rules$table,
  col.names = c("Method", names(s02_rules$table)[-1]),
  caption = "Genus F1 per method, default settings, mean over the nine databases: no_truth_aside / q2b."
)
```
